title: should normalize legacy object-format colOrder to an array on apply
verifies: a legacy object-format colOrder is normalized to an array and columns render in the encoded order with the timestamp pinned first

title: should preserve array-format colOrder order when applying a saved view
verifies: an array-format colOrder survives the mergeDeep apply and columns render in the exact saved order

title: should fall back to stored selectedFields order when colOrder is absent
verifies: a saved view without a colOrder key restores columns from the stored selectedFields order
